2-who-d-proposed.png.question: Q2
2-who-d-proposed.png.caption: Proposed, drawn in. What a scheduler sees on pressing "CAPS": the week's figures (2a); the people who fly this week first (2b), those not done at the top in amber, "Not done" (2c); then everyone else on the Quals page, under "Not flying this week" (2d). Each man's two tests and the check's switch (Q5) on his row; the four whose Ops limits have run out (the third figure) sit further down, out of this picture. The flyers are the real ones of this demo week (38 flying, 58 pilots and WSOs on the Quals page); who has not done it is made up for the picture.
